sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:12

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:12:1
items.html: Being close to the root of Keter she cannot shine, and her light is nullified in the light drawn from Keter: That is to say, had the degrees not descended, but the light of Keter been in the vessel of Keter and the light of Hochma in the vessel of Hochma, and so forth, then the light of Hochma would not have been able to bestow upon the Guf [body], since she is nullified then in the light of Keter — for all the lower Sefirot are nullified and are not recognisable against the upper Sefira of the degree. And therefore every degree, although there are ten Sefirot in it, is named only after the highest of them, as is known. And therefore it is impossible for the light of Hochma to be revealed below unless the coupling be made upon phase three alone, for then the degrees descend and the light of Hochma comes into the vessel of Keter, whereupon the light of Hochma will be the upper Sefira and its illumination will be recognisable.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:12:2
items.html: ZON are outside their vessel, and if so Hochma cannot bestow: That is to say, that as long as they are in the Rosh [head] they are found to be without a vessel. And therefore, as long as the degrees are in their place and the light of the upper Keter is in the aspect of its own vessel, behold, its illumination always reaches the ZON, and they are not ready to receive from another light smaller than it. And therefore the degrees must descend, so that the light of Keter shall not shine in its own vessel, but the light of Hochma. As above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:12:3
items.html: Hochma will become distant and descend below into the place of Bina, etc., and then her place will remain vacant. This means that at the time when the degree of Hochma descends to the degree of Bina, the degree of Hochma is found vacant, and there is no other place for the light of Hochma to clothe in except in the vessel of Keter, since her own vessel serves the light of Bina.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:12:4
items.html: While the abundance bestowed from the root of Keter fills that place of the vacant space, then Hochma bestows downward: This means that while the light drawn from the vessel of Keter fills that lacking degree of Hochma — that is, that the light of Hochma herself clothes there, as above — behold, then the degree of Hochma bestows downward and is not nullified in the light of Keter, as above, she being now the upper Sefira in the Rosh [head], with no other degree above her.
